categories.P_WORD: person: name that is also a common word
categories.P_PROSE: person: only in prose, never before a speech verb
categories.P_PREFIX_ONCE: person: once, only with a prefix letter
categories.P_CORRUPT_ONLY: person: only in corrupted form, never cleanly
categories.P_TWO_SPELL: person: same person, one clean and one corrupted spelling
categories.P_FORMS: person: full name, surname alone, first name alone
categories.P_SHARED_SURNAME: person: two people sharing a surname
categories.P_ED1_PAIR: person: two people edit-distance 1 apart (must not merge)
categories.P_ROLE_NOCOLON: person: role word directly before, no colon
categories.P_HYPHEN: person: hyphenated surname, elsewhere with a space
categories.P_SPLITRUN: person: name split across two runs mid-word
categories.P_LOOKS_ORG: person: name that reads like a body's
categories.O_PRIVATE: org: private body, must be redacted
categories.O_PUBLIC: org: public body, must not be redacted
categories.O_LOOKS_PERSON: org: body whose name reads like a person's
categories.T_NUMBERS: trap: case numbers, dates, section references
categories.T_IDIOM: trap: idiom or public title beside a same-word name
categories.P_ROLE_COLON: person: party by role word and colon, first name only
categories.P_AFTER_LEAD: person: name right after a discourse word (כאמור, משכך, לדבריה)
categories.T_FORMLABEL: trap: form label with a colon (not a speaker)
categories.T_TZSPLIT: trap: word ending in ת before a word starting with ז (not ת"ז)
categories.T_UNDERSIGNED: trap: הח"מ before a verb (not a name)
categories.O_ROLEWORD: trap: role word in any spelling (אפוטרופא, אפוטרופוס)
categories.T_GAZWORD: trap: ordinary word that is also a locality name (קדימה, לשם, גבעות)
categories.P_MINOR_ANCH: person: minor introduced by הקטין / הקטינה
categories.P_SPEAKERLINE: person: speaker written on a line of its own (no colon)
categories.P_ROLE_TEACHER: person: foreign first name only after a care or teaching role word, in child speech
categories.P_WORD_VERB: person: everyday word as a first name, before a speech verb (lexicon-aided by design)
